mapper.select: SELECT id FROM mission WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id, m.code, m.status, m.demo_only, m.current_version_id, cv.version AS current_version, cr.version AS current_rubric_version, pv.version AS published_version, pr.version AS published_rubric_version FROM mission m JOIN mission_version cv ON cv.id = m.current_version_id LEFT JOIN rubric_version cr ON cr.id = m.current_rubric_version_id LEFT JOIN mission_version pv ON pv.id = m.published_version_id LEFT JOIN rubric_version pr ON pr.id = m.published_rubric_version_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
SELECT status, count(*) AS count FROM mission GROUP BY status

SELECT version, title, subject, grade_min, grade_max, thinking_type, input_type, question, guide, scene_uri, static_scene_uri, COALESCE(achievement_standards, '[]'::jsonb) AS achievement_standards, COALESCE(choices, '[]'::jsonb) AS choices, COALESCE(categories, '[]'::jsonb) AS categories, answer_unit, COALESCE(input_template, '[]'::jsonb) AS input_template, created_at FROM mission_version WHERE mission_id = #{missionId} ORDER BY version

SELECT v.version AS mission_version, rv.version AS rubric_version, r.result, r.comment, r.reviewer_id, r.created_at FROM mission_review r JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = r.mission_version_id JOIN rubric_version rv ON rv.id = r.rubric_version_id WHERE r.mission_id = #{missionId} ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id
SELECT COALESCE(max(version), 0) + 1 FROM mission_version WHERE mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (id, code, status, demo_only, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, 'DRAFT', #{demoOnly}, #{sortOrder}, #{authorId}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO mission_version (id, mission_id, version, title, subject, grade_min, grade_max, thinking_type, input_type, question, guide, scene_uri, static_scene_uri, achievement_standards, choices, categories, answer_unit, input_template, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{missionId}, #{version}, #{command.title}, #{command.subject}, #{command.gradeMin}, #{command.gradeMax}, #{command.thinkingType}, #{command.inputType}, #{command.question}, #{command.guide,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{command.sceneUri,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{command.staticSceneUri,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{command.achievementStandards,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler}, #{command.choices,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.ChoiceListTypeHandler}, #{command.categories,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.CategoryListTypeHandler}, #{command.answerUnit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{command.inputTemplate,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler}, #{command.authorId}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET current_version_id = #{versionId}, demo_only = #{demoOnly}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{missionId}
UPDATE mission SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{missionId}
